text: Experimentally determined target-bound cyclic peptides closed by disulfide: ring spans 8-13 residues (IQR), median 10 (n=301 complexes).
Experimentally determined target-bound cyclic peptides closed by head to tail: ring spans 7-11 residues (IQR), median 8 (n=174 complexes).
Experimentally determined target-bound cyclic peptides closed by amide like: ring spans 5-10 residues (IQR), median 7 (n=137 complexes).
Experimentally determined target-bound cyclic peptides closed by thioether: ring spans 9-12 residues (IQR), median 12 (n=67 complexes).
At peptide positions in contact with the target, D-residue rate 0.053 vs 0.069 elsewhere; N-methyl rate 0.047 vs 0.022 elsewhere (n=10443 positions).
Backbone amide NH groups in bound cyclic peptides: 0.47 intramolecularly H-bonded, 0.10 H-bonded to the receptor only, 0.43 free (n=8909 NH groups).
Residues enriched at the interface (log2 odds interface vs other positions): I +1.92, W +1.69, F +1.41, Y +0.93, V +0.70; depleted: Q -0.94, A -0.82, C -0.82, E -0.72, K -0.45 (n=8494 positions).
